# form API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Typed Form families, RHF value ownership and native Fluent bindings.

## createForm

Creates a stable typed Form family, optionally binding one validation owner.
Live methods read TInput; a schema/resolver may submit a distinct transformed TOutput.
Create the factory outside render. Input binds the entire string domain and has no codec.

### Imports

```ts
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Use when

- A stable form family should type-check live paths and validated output with one validation owner.

### Avoid when

- Existing raw RHF methods or methods from another factory must be reused unchanged; the returned Root accepts only its own suite’s methods.

### Ownership and dependencies

The no-argument overload leaves rules or Root validation unbound. Passing a Standard Schema directly infers live input and submit output; passing one schema/resolver option binds that owner permanently. Validation never rewrites live values into output values. Fields require the same suite’s Root, with compatible React Hook Form, shared Fluent/Griffel and date/time compat peers. No SPFx provider is required. Native Form resource mappings must be configured in the SPFx host even when supplying complete UI overrides.

### Errors and asynchronous work

Root awaits validation, onSubmit and returned onInvalid promises and gates duplicate native submissions. Submit and Reset follow pending state; fields remain editable. Direct methods.handleSubmit retains RHF behavior and bypasses the DOM gate. Expected service failures belong in methods.setError; unexpected validation failures use __formValidation and unexpected submit/invalid-callback failures use root.submit. Pending clears so later attempts can succeed.

### Records and reset

Default values initialize the baseline; load another record with reset(newRecord), rather than relying on object identity. Reset/resetField synchronize adapter drafts even for same-valued records. keepDirtyValues is explicit and preserves eligible dirty drafts; primitive remounts can change native ref identity. Browser files cannot be restored by defaults or reset.

### Required metadata and validation

The required prop supplies visible and accessible metadata; it does not create a validation rule. Choose field rules, a schema or a resolver as the validation owner. Callers own persistence and domain messages; expected service failures can use same-suite `methods.setError('root.serverError', { message: 'Please try again.' })`.

### Custom control ownership

Invoke suite useField inside its owning Root or scope. Supply a truthful native/RHF ref and your own accessible name, hint/error associations and focus target. A custom binding does not consume SettingsGroup field-row naming; use an ordinary row when composing one.

### Throws

- TypeError - Untyped configuration supplies both owners or neither valid schema/resolver owner.

### Examples

#### Typed order editor

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';

const Order = createForm<{ reference: string }>();
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return (
    <Order.Root
      defaultValues={{ reference: '' }}
      onSubmit={values => {
        console.log(values.reference);
      }}
    >
      <Order.Input name="reference" />
      <Order.Submit>Save</Order.Submit>
    </Order.Root>
  );
}
```

#### Rules-only profile editor

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';

type ProfileValues = { name: string; newsletter: boolean };
const Profile = createForm<ProfileValues>();
export function ProfileEditor({ saveProfile }: { saveProfile: (values: ProfileValues) => Promise<void> }): React.ReactElement {
  return <Profile.Root defaultValues={{ name: '', newsletter: false }}
    onSubmit={async values => { await saveProfile(values); }}>
    <Profile.Input name="name" label="Name" required rules={{ required: 'Enter your name.' }} />
    <Profile.Switch name="newsletter" label="Newsletter" />
    <Profile.Error />
    <Profile.Submit>Save</Profile.Submit>
    <Profile.Reset>Reset</Profile.Reset>
  </Profile.Root>;
}
```

#### Settings rows as Form fields

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

type AccountValues = { profile: { name: string; enabled: boolean } };
const Account = createForm<AccountValues>();
export function AccountEditor({ saveAccount }: { saveAccount: (values: AccountValues) => Promise<void> }): React.ReactElement {
  return <Account.Root defaultValues={{ profile: { name: '', enabled: true } }}
    onSubmit={async values => { await saveAccount(values); }}>
    <Account.Object name="profile">{({ Fields }) =>
      <SettingsGroup title="Profile">
        <SettingsGroup.Item field title="Name" description="The name shown to your colleagues.">
          <Fields.Input name="name" required rules={{ required: 'Enter a name.' }} />
        </SettingsGroup.Item>
        <SettingsGroup.Item field title="Enabled" description="Allow this account to receive updates.">
          <Fields.Switch name="enabled" />
        </SettingsGroup.Item>
      </SettingsGroup>
    }</Account.Object>
    <Account.Error />
    <Account.Submit>Save</Account.Submit>
    <Account.Reset>Reset</Account.Reset>
  </Account.Root>;
}
```

#### Custom native input binding

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';

const Notes = createForm<{ note: string }>();

function CustomNote(): React.ReactElement {
  const field = Notes.useField<string>({ name: 'note', rules: { required: 'Enter a note.' } });
  return <label>
    Note
    <input ref={field.ref} value={field.value} disabled={field.disabled}
      aria-invalid={field.invalid}
      onChange={event => field.onChange(event.currentTarget.value)}
      onBlur={field.onBlur} />
  </label>;
}

export function NotesEditor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Notes.Root defaultValues={{ note: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values.note); }}>
    <CustomNote />
    <Notes.Error name="note" />
    <Notes.Submit>Save</Notes.Submit>
  </Notes.Root>;
}
```

#### Configure local appointment date and wall-clock time

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
// Fluent compat DatePicker and TimePicker require null for their empty domains.
const Appointment = createForm<{ when: { date: Date | null; time: Date | null } }>();
function AppointmentEditor({ save }: { save: (when: { date: Date | null; time: Date | null }) => Promise<void> }) {
  return <Appointment.Root defaultValues={{ when: { date: null, time: null } }} onSubmit={values => save(values.when)}>
    <Appointment.DateTime name="when" label="Appointment" dateLabel="Date" timeLabel="Time"
      datePickerProps={{ allowTextInput: true, firstDayOfWeek: 1 }}
      timePickerProps={{ freeform: true, hourCycle: 'h23', increment: 15 }} />
    <Appointment.Error name="when" /><Appointment.Submit>Save</Appointment.Submit>
  </Appointment.Root>;
}
```

#### Localize controls and one form instance

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { EditableText, Pagination, Stage, createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const ReportForm = createForm<{ title: string }>();
function LocalizedReport() {
  const methods = ReportForm.useForm({ defaultValues: { title: '' }, strings: {
    unexpectedFailure: 'The report could not be saved.', fileInput: { browseLabel: 'Attach report' },
  } });
  return <section>
    <Pagination pagination={{ type: 'pages', pageIndex: 0, pageSize: 10, totalItems: 25 }} strings={{ nextPage: 'Next report page' }} />
    <Stage presentation="dialog" trigger={<button>Open report</button>}>
      <Stage.Header title="Report" strings={{ closeLabel: 'Dismiss report' }} /><Stage.Body>Report details</Stage.Body>
    </Stage>
    <EditableText value="<h2>Report</h2>" mode="read" strings={{ formattingControls: 'Report formatting' }} />
    <ReportForm.Root methods={methods} onSubmit={() => { throw new Error('Service unavailable'); }}>
      <ReportForm.Input name="title" label="Title" /><ReportForm.Error /><ReportForm.Submit>Save</ReportForm.Submit>
    </ReportForm.Root>
  </section>;
}
```

### Signatures

```ts
<TInput extends FieldValues>(): FormSuite<TInput, unknown, TInput, false>
```

Creates a rules-only or Root-configured family with this live model.

#### Type parameters

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

#### Returns

A stable suite whose methods, fields and Root share one private ownership identity.

Infers the live input and transformed output from a Standard Schema.

#### Type parameters (2)

- `TSchema`: Standard Schema v1 whose input and output infer the suite models.

#### Parameters

- `schema`: Standard Schema v1 validator used to infer and permanently bind live input and submit output.

#### Returns (2)

A stable suite whose methods, fields and Root share one private ownership identity.

```ts
<TInput extends FieldValues, TOutput = TInput, TContext = unknown>(options: { schema: StandardSchemaV1<TInput, TOutput>; resolver?: undefined; } | { resolver: Resolver<TInput, TContext, TOutput>; schema?: undefined; }): FormSuite<TInput, TContext, TOutput, true>
```

Permanently binds one schema or resolver owner.

#### Type parameters (3)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TOutput`: Validated submission model, which can differ from live input; defaults to TInput where optional.
- `TContext`: Context passed to the React Hook Form resolver; defaults to unknown where optional.

#### Parameters (2)

- `options`: Exactly one validation owner; its input stays live and its output reaches onSubmit.

#### Returns (3)

A stable family with validation ownership fixed for Root and useForm.

## FormArrayComponent

Generic Array member retaining path-specific item model inference.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { FormArrayComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormArrayComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormArrayComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import { createForm, FormArrayComponent } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ rows: { sku: string }[] }>();
const Rows: FormArrayComponent<{ rows: { sku: string }[] }> = Order.Array;
```

### Type

```ts
type FormArrayComponent<TInput extends FieldValues> = <TPath extends FormArrayPath<TInput>>(props: FormArrayProps<TInput, TPath>) => React.ReactElement
```

### Signatures (2)

```ts
<TPath extends FormArrayPath<TInput>>(props: FormArrayProps<TInput, TPath>): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Type parameters (4)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TPath`: Selected nested object/structured-array path, retaining its exact child model.

#### Parameters (3)

- `props`: Required relative structured-array name and children render callback, plus optional array rules when no schema/resolver owns validation. Requires the same suite’s Root; no native attributes or ref are accepted.

#### Returns (4)

The children render result with stable item metadata and array operations, without adding layout DOM or forwarding a ref.

## FormArrayContext

Headless RHF record-array operations; operations never move native focus.
Invalid indices and duplicate/empty removal lists are no-ops. Disabled Roots/scopes
suppress every operation. update/replace use RHF's new-item/remount semantics.

## FormArraySectionProps

Visual structured array with stable ordered items and constrained Add/Remove/Move actions.
Bounds constrain these UI actions, not validation, resets or external method writes.
Action focus skips unavailable targets; external resets never initiate focus movement.

```tsx
const props = {
  name: 'rows', title: 'Rows', createItem: () => ({ sku: '' }), renderItem: ({ Fields }) => <Fields.Input name="sku" />,
} satisfies FormArraySectionProps<{ rows: { sku: string }[] }, 'rows'>;
```

### Type (9)

```ts
type FormArraySectionProps<TInput extends FieldValues, TPath extends FormArrayPath<TInput>> = FormSectionProps & {
    /** Relative structured-record array path. Primitive arrays use multi-value adapters. */
    name: TPath;
    /**
     * Creates one complete live-domain record for each allowed Add action.
     * @returns One complete live-domain record; the allowed Add action appends it.
     */
    createItem: () => FormArrayItemValue<TInput, TPath>;
    /**
     * Renders caller-owned fields/layout using stable relative item metadata.
     * @param item - Current stable item metadata and relative Fields; render callbacks must be pure.
```

## FormArraySectionStrings

Localized visible actions, accessible action names and polite status announcements. Every callback receives the current item label; moved also receives one-based position and total.

### Imports (11)

```ts
import type { FormArraySectionStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormArraySectionStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormArraySectionStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (11)

```ts
import { FormArraySectionStrings } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const strings: FormArraySectionStrings = {
  add: 'Aggiungi',
  empty: 'Nessuna riga',
  remove: label => `Elimina ${label}`
};
```

### Members (5)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FormArraySectionStrings.add` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | — | Add button text; defaults to Add item.<br>When omitted, the per-form native arraySection.add label is used. |
| `FormArraySectionStrings.added` | `((label: string) => string) \| undefined` | Optional | — | Announcement after adding an item.<br>When omitted, the per-form native added formatter is used. |
| `FormArraySectionStrings.empty` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | — | Empty-array text; defaults to No items.<br>When omitted, the per-form native arraySection.empty text is used. |
| `FormArraySectionStrings.moveDown` | `((label: string) => string) \| undefined` | Optional | — | Visible and accessible Move down action text.<br>When omitted, the per-form native moveDown formatter is used. |
| `FormArraySectionStrings.moveUp` | `((label: string) => string) \| undefined` | Optional | — | Visible and accessible Move up action text.<br>When omitted, the per-form native moveUp formatter is used. |

| `FormArraySectionStrings.remove` | `((label: string) => string) \| undefined` | Optional | — | Visible and accessible Remove action text.<br>When omitted, the per-form native remove formatter is used. |
| `FormArraySectionStrings.removed` | `((label: string) => string) \| undefined` | Optional | — | Announcement after removing an item.<br>When omitted, the per-form native removed formatter is used. |

### Type (17)

```ts
type FormSectionName = {
    /** Literal phrasing content inside the native legend. Objects/callbacks configure an inner span and its ref. */
    title: ContentSlot<'span'>;
    /**
     * Optional explicit accessible name overriding the legend.
     * When omitted, the native legend names the section unless aria-labelledby overrides it.
     */
    'aria-label'?: string;
    /**
     * Optional ID references overriding the legend.
     * When omitted, aria-label supplies the name when present; otherwise the native legend names the section.
     */
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
} | {
    /**
     * Optional literal legend content; object/callback refs identify its inner span.
     * When omitted, supply an explicit outer accessible name; no visible legend is added.
     */
    title?: ContentSlot<'span'>;
    /** Explicit accessible name when a legend is omitted. */
    'aria-label': string;
    /**
     * Optional external naming element IDs.
     * When omitted, the required aria-label names the section.
     */
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
} | {
    /**
     * Optional literal legend content; object/callback refs identify its inner span.
     * When omitted, supply an explicit outer accessible name; no visible legend is added.
     */
    title?: ContentSlot<'span'>;
    /**
     * Optional explicit accessible name.
     * When omitted, the required aria-labelledby references name the section.
     */
    'aria-label'?: string;
    /** External naming element IDs when a legend is omitted. */
    'aria-labelledby': string;
}
```

Caller children own custom layout; generated styles use toolkit classes.

### Type (18)

```ts
type FormSectionProps = Omit<React.FieldsetHTMLAttributes<HTMLFieldSetElement>, 'name' | 'title' | 'children' | 'disabled' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' | 'aria-label' | 'aria-labelledby'> & FormSectionName & {
    /**
     * Literal description in the native hint; props/callbacks configure an inner div and its ref.
     * Empty static objects render their container without adding an empty aria-describedby reference.
     * When omitted, no additional description content or association is requested.
     */
    description?: ContentSlot<'div'>;
    /**
     * Adds to Root and enclosing scope restrictions and omits disabled adapter values on submission.
     * When omitted or false, adds no disabled restriction; enclosing Root/scope restrictions still apply.
     */
    disabled?: boolean;
    /**
     * Native Fluent Card appearance; defaults to filled.
     * When omitted, the native Fluent primitive appearance applies.
     * @defaultValue filled
     */
    appearance?: 'outline' | 'filled' | 'filled-alternative' | 'subtle';
}
```

## CompatibleFieldPath

Paths which can both supply the control's value and accept its complete write domain.
Optional fields may initialize absent; controlled inputs require suitable defaults.

### Imports (21)

```ts
import type { CompatibleFieldPath } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { CompatibleFieldPath } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { CompatibleFieldPath } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (21)

```ts
import { CompatibleFieldPath } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
type StringPath = CompatibleFieldPath<{ title: string; count: number }, string>;
const name: StringPath = 'title';
```

### Type parameters (20)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TValue`: Complete domain read and written by the custom control.

### Type (19)

```ts
type CompatibleFieldPath<TInput extends FieldValues, TValue> = {
    [TName in FieldPath<TInput>]: [
        Exclude<FieldPathValue<TInput, TName>, undefined>
    ] extends [
        TValue
    ] ? [
        TValue
    ] extends [
        FieldPathValue<TInput, TName>
    ] ? TName : never : never;
}[FieldPath<TInput>]
```

## FormCheckboxGroupProps

Checkbox group for string identities in declared option order.
Direct Fluent Checkbox children are the only children adapted; other content is retained.
The public div ref is separate from RHF focus on the first eligible checkbox.

### Imports (22)

```ts
import type { FormCheckboxGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormCheckboxGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormCheckboxGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (22)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormCheckboxGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ tags: string[] }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'tags', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }] } satisfies FormCheckboxGroupProps<{ tags: string[] }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ tags: [] }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.CheckboxGroup {...fieldProps} label="Tags" options={[{ value: "work", label: "Work" }]} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (21)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

### Type (20)

```ts
type FormCheckboxGroupProps<TInput extends FieldValues> = FormSelectionBinding<TInput, string[]> & FormOptionsSource & Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children' | 'onChange' | 'onBlur' | 'className'> & {
    /**
     * Runs after RHF writes the group selection, before the child callbacks.
     * When omitted, RHF updates and internal presentation still run without a consumer notification. Returned promises are not awaited.
     */
    onChange?: CheckboxProps['onChange'];
    /**
     * Runs after RHF marks the field touched, before the child's blur callback.
     * When omitted, RHF still marks the field touched without a consumer notification. Returned promises are not awaited.
     */
    onBlur?: CheckboxProps['onBlur'];
}
```

### Source (41)

[packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts:461](https://github.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/blob/main/packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts#L461)

## FormCheckboxProps

Checkbox binding with explicit opt-in to Fluent's mixed state.
A boolean field accepts the default mode. A `boolean | 'mixed'` field requires
`triState: true`. Change/blur callbacks run after RHF; the ref targets the input.

### Imports (23)

```ts
import type { FormCheckboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormCheckboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormCheckboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (23)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormCheckboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ approved: boolean }>();
const fieldProps: FormCheckboxProps<{ approved: boolean }> = { name: 'approved' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ approved: false }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Checkbox {...fieldProps} label="Approved" />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (22)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

### Type (21)

```ts
type FormCheckboxProps<TInput extends FieldValues> = Omit<CheckboxProps, keyof FormFieldPresentationProps | 'checked' | 'defaultChecked' | 'name' | 'value'> & (
    (FormControlProps<TInput, boolean> & {
        /**
         * Keeps the complete live domain boolean when omitted or false.
         * @defaultValue false
         */
        triState?: false;
    }) | (FormControlProps<TInput, boolean | 'mixed'> & {
        /**
         * Explicit true selects mixed-state mode; the field must accept both booleans and Fluent’s mixed value. This required discriminant has no omission default.
         */
        triState: true;
    })
)
```

## FormColorPickerProps

HSV ColorPicker with optional alpha, copied on every read and write.
Compose Fluent ColorArea, ColorSlider or AlphaSlider children. The ref targets
the root div; RHF error focus targets an eligible native range input.

### Imports (24)

```ts
import type { FormColorPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormColorPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormColorPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (24)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ColorSlider } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { createForm, FormColorPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ accent: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a?: number } }>();
const fieldProps: FormColorPickerProps<{ accent: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a?: number } }> = { name: 'accent' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ accent: { h: 210, s: 0.7, v: 0.8 } }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.ColorPicker {...fieldProps} label="Accent"><ColorSlider channel="hue" /></Order.ColorPicker>
  </Order.Root>;
}
```


## FormComboboxMultiProps

Multiple Combobox keeps query edits separate from its ordered selected identities.
Selection clears query. Reset clears drafts unless their dirty owner is preserved.

### Imports (25)

```ts
import type { FormComboboxMultiProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormComboboxMultiProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormComboboxMultiProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (25)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormComboboxMultiProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ countries: string[] }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'countries', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }] } satisfies FormComboboxMultiProps<{ countries: string[] }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ countries: [] }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.ComboboxMulti {...fieldProps} label="Countries" options={[{ value: "it", label: "Italy" }]} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```


### Source (44)

[packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts:442](https://github.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/blob/main/packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts#L442)

## FormComboboxProps

Single Combobox separates query presentation from selected identity.
Unmatched queries write the empty identity; schema/rules decide its validity.
Reset clears drafts; explicit `keepDirtyValues` preserves dirty field drafts.

### Imports (26)

```ts
import type { FormComboboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormComboboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormComboboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (26)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormComboboxProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ country: string }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'country', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }] } satisfies FormComboboxProps<{ country: string }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ country: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Combobox {...fieldProps} label="Country" options={[{ value: "it", label: "Italy" }]} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

## FormControlProps

Binding props for a control that reads and writes one complete value domain.

### Imports (27)

```ts
import type { FormControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (27)

```ts
import { FormControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const props: FormControlProps<{ title: string }, string> = {
  name: 'title', label: 'Title', rules: { required: 'Enter a title.' },
};
```

### Type parameters (26)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TValue`: Complete domain read and written by the custom control.
- `TName`: Compatible relative field path; defaults to all paths accepting the complete value domain.

### Type (25)

```ts
type FormControlProps<TInput extends FieldValues, TValue, TName extends CompatibleFieldPath<TInput, TValue> = CompatibleFieldPath<TInput, TValue>> = FormFieldPresentationProps & {
    /** Relative field path; object/array scopes supply its prefix. */
    name: TName;
    /**
     * Domain validation; disallowed when a schema/resolver owns validation.
     * When omitted, no field or array domain rules are registered here; schema/resolver ownership remains unchanged.
     */
    rules?: RegisterOptions<TInput, TName>;
}
```

## FormDatePickerControlProps

Package-owned DatePicker configuration without its Form field binding.

### Imports (28)

```ts
import type { FormDatePickerControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormDatePickerControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormDatePickerControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (28)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormDatePickerControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ date: Date | null }>();
const datePickerProps: FormDatePickerControlProps = { allowTextInput: true, firstDayOfWeek: 1 };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ date: null }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.DatePicker name="date" label="Date" allowTextInput />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type (26)

```ts
type FormDatePickerControlProps = FormDateTimeNativeInputProps & {
  /**
   * Fluent input appearance.
   * When omitted, the native Fluent primitive appearance applies.
   * @defaultValue outline
   */
  appearance?: InputProps['appearance'];
  /**
   * Allows direct date text entry. Defaults to `false`. Uncommitted or rejected text blocks validation and submission until corrected, cleared, or reset.
   * When omitted, direct date text entry is disabled.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  allowTextInput?: boolean;
  /**
   * Localized error for text that does not match the committed date. Omission inherits the per-form `dateInputValidationMessage` from the native resource or hook dictionary. Domain constraints remain owned by rules, schema, or resolver.
   * When omitted, the per-form dictionary supplies the corresponding date/time draft error.
   */
  inputValidationMessage?: string;
  /**
   * Allows disabled calendar elements to receive focus. Defaults to `false`.
   * When omitted, disabled calendar elements are not focusable.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  allFocusable?: boolean;
  /**
   * Removes the DatePicker border. Defaults to `false`.
   * When omitted, the native border treatment remains.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  borderless?: boolean;
  /**
   * Additional class name applied to the DatePicker root.
   * When omitted, only the component and Fluent classes apply.
   */
  className?: string;
  /**
   * Prevents interaction.
   * When omitted or false, adds no disabled restriction; enclosing Root/scope restrictions still apply.
   */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /**
   * Prevents automatic popup opening on focus.
   * When omitted, automatic popup focus is suppressed (compat defaults disableAutoFocus to true).
   * @defaultValue true
   */
  disableAutoFocus?: boolean;
  /**
   * Opens the calendar initially.
   * When omitted, the popup starts closed.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /**
   * Package-owned localized calendar formatting functions.
   * When omitted, compat calendar formatting functions apply; input formatting remains controlled by formatDate.
   */
  dateTimeFormatter?: FormDatePickerFormatting;
  /**
   * First weekday displayed by the calendar.
   * When omitted, compat uses Sunday (0).
   * @defaultValue 0
   */
  firstDayOfWeek?: FormDatePickerDayOfWeek;
  /**
   * Rule used to determine the first week of a year.
   * When omitted, compat uses FirstDay (0).
   * @defaultValue 0
   */
  firstWeekOfYear?: FormDatePickerFirstWeekOfYear;
  /**
   * Synchronously formats the selected local date as input text; defaults to YYYY-MM-DD, or empty text for undefined. Pair custom formats with parseDateFromString.
   * @param date - Selected local calendar Date; omitted/undefined means no selected date.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatDate?: (date?: Date) => string;
  /**
   * Highlights the current month.
   * When omitted, compat does not highlight the current month.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  highlightCurrentMonth?: boolean;
  /**
   * Highlights the selected month.
   * When omitted, compat does not highlight the selected month.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  highlightSelectedMonth?: boolean;
  /**
   * Date initially highlighted when the calendar opens.
   * When omitted, compat captures the current client date as its initial picker date; an existing selected date takes priority.
   */
  initialPickerDate?: Date;
  /**
   * Renders the popup in DOM order rather than through a portal.
   * When omitted, Fluent renders the popup through its portal.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  inlinePopup?: boolean;
  /**
   * Shows the month picker.
   * When omitted, compat shows the month picker.
   * @defaultValue true
   */
  isMonthPickerVisible?: boolean;
  /**
   * Inclusive latest selectable local calendar date; omission supplies no upper bound. Domain constraints still belong to rules/schema/resolver.
   * When omitted, no calendar upper bound applies.
   */
  maxDate?: Date;
  /**
   * Inclusive earliest selectable local calendar date; omission supplies no lower bound. Domain constraints still belong to rules/schema/resolver.
   * When omitted, no calendar lower bound applies.
   */
  minDate?: Date;
  /**
   * Controlled popup open state.
   * When omitted, the popup owns its open state using defaultOpen.
   */
  open?: boolean;
  /**
   * Opens the calendar when the input is clicked. Defaults to `true`.
   * When omitted, clicking the date input opens its popup.
   * @defaultValue true
   */
  openOnClick?: boolean;
  /**
   * Synchronous popup-open notification; receives the proposed boolean state. Update open externally when controlled; the return value is ignored.
   * When omitted, no application popup notification runs; uncontrolled native state still updates. Returned promises are not awaited.
   * @param open - Proposed popup open state; controlled consumers must update their open prop.
   */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /**
   * Synchronous notification after an accepted calendar or text commit writes RHF. Receives the local Date or legacy compat null for clear; the return value is ignored.
   * When omitted, RHF commits still occur without a consumer notification. Returned promises are not awaited.
   * @param date - Committed local calendar Date, or legacy compat null when cleared, after the adapter’s accepted RHF write.
   */
  // Compat date/time selection and parser contracts explicitly use null for empty values.
  // eslint-disable-next-line @rushstack/no-new-null
  onSelectDate?: (date: Date | null) => void;
  /**
   * Synchronous date-validation notification with the package-owned error identifier or undefined for success. Invalid drafts keep the committed value; the return value is ignored.
   * @param data - Date text-validation result: error is undefined for valid text or contains the package-owned error identifier; rejected text retains the previously committed date.
   */
  onValidationResult?: (data: FormDatePickerValidationResult) => void;
  /**
   * Synchronously parses direct input text into a local date; return null for rejected text, following the compat parser contract.
   * When omitted, strict local YYYY-MM-DD parsing accepts only real calendar dates in years 0000–9999; no UTC/timestamp fallback occurs.
   * @param dateText - Direct input text to parse synchronously in local calendar coordinates.
   * @returns Local Date, or legacy compat null for rejected text. No promise is supported.
   */
  // Compat date/time selection and parser contracts explicitly use null for empty values.
  // eslint-disable-next-line @rushstack/no-new-null
  parseDateFromString?: (dateText: string) => Date | null;
  /**
   * Placeholder shown when no date is selected.
   * When omitted, no placeholder text is supplied by the adapter.
   */
  placeholder?: string;
  /**
   * Presents the control as required without replacing validation rules.
   * When omitted, no required presentation metadata is added; supply validation rules separately.
   */
  required?: boolean;
  /**
   * Shows the calendar close action.
   * When omitted, compat hides the calendar close action.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  showCloseButton?: boolean;
  /**
   * Shows the action that navigates to today.
   * When omitted, compat shows the today action.
   * @defaultValue true
   */
  showGoToToday?: boolean;
```

## FormDatePickerFormatting

Package-owned localized formatting functions used by Form.DatePicker's calendar.

### Imports (32)

```ts
import type { FormDatePickerFormatting } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormDatePickerFormatting } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormDatePickerFormatting } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (32)

```ts
import { FormDatePickerFormatting } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const formatter: FormDatePickerFormatting = {
  formatDay: date => String(date.getDate()),
  formatMonth: (date, strings) => strings.months[date.getMonth()],
  formatYear: date => String(date.getFullYear()),
  formatMonthDayYear: date => date.toLocaleDateString('it-IT'),
  formatMonthYear: date => date.toLocaleDateString('it-IT', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }),
};
```

### Type (30)

```ts
type FormDatePickerFormatting = {
  /**
   * Formats a day number.
   * @param date - Required Date whose local calendar parts are formatted; this calendar callback does not accept an absent date.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatDay: (date: Date) => string;
  /**
   * Formats a month using the supplied localized strings.
   * @param date - Required Date whose local calendar parts are formatted; this calendar callback does not accept an absent date.
   * @param strings - Resolved localized calendar strings supplied to the synchronous formatter.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatMonth: (date: Date, strings: FormDatePickerStrings) => string;
  /**
   * Formats a year.
   * @param date - Required Date whose local calendar parts are formatted; this calendar callback does not accept an absent date.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatYear: (date: Date) => string;
  /**
   * Formats a complete month, day, and year.
   * @param date - Required Date whose local calendar parts are formatted; this calendar callback does not accept an absent date.
   * @param strings - Resolved localized calendar strings supplied to the synchronous formatter.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatMonthDayYear: (date: Date, strings: FormDatePickerStrings) => string;
  /**
   * Formats a month and year.
   * @param date - Required Date whose local calendar parts are formatted; this calendar callback does not accept an absent date.
   * @param strings - Resolved localized calendar strings supplied to the synchronous formatter.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatMonthYear: (date: Date, strings: FormDatePickerStrings) => string;
}
```

```tsx
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ date: null }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.DatePicker {...fieldProps} label="Date" allowTextInput />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type (32)

```ts
type FormDatePickerStrings = {
  /** Full month names beginning with January. */
  months: readonly string[];
  /** Abbreviated month names beginning with January. */
  shortMonths: readonly string[];
  /** Full weekday names beginning with Sunday. */
  days: readonly string[];
  /** Abbreviated weekday names beginning with Sunday. */
  shortDays: readonly string[];
  /** Label for the action that navigates to today. */
  goToToday: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for navigating to the previous month.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  prevMonthAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for navigating to the next month.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  nextMonthAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for navigating to the previous year.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  prevYearAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for navigating to the next year.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  nextYearAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for navigating to the previous year range.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  prevYearRangeAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for navigating to the next year range.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  nextYearRangeAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible format string for the month-picker header.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  monthPickerHeaderAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible format string for the year-picker header.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  yearPickerHeaderAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label for the calendar close action.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  closeButtonAriaLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible format string for a week number.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  weekNumberFormatString?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible format string for the selected date.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  selectedDateFormatString?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible format string for today's date.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  todayDateFormatString?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible label announced for marked dates.
   * When omitted, the per-form native calendar string remains in use.
   */
  dayMarkedAriaLabel?: string;
}
```

```tsx
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ appointment: { date: null, time: null } }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
```

### Type parameters (28)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

### Type (35)

```ts
type FormDateTimeProps<TInput extends FieldValues> = FormControlProps<
  TInput,
  FormDateTimeValue
> & {
  /**
   * Explicit identity of the semantic date/time group.
   * When omitted, the binding uses generated native Field/control identity.
   */
  id?: string;
  /**
   * Additional descriptions appended to group hint and validation relationships.
   * When omitted, only adapter-owned hint/error relationships apply.
   */
  'aria-describedby'?: string;
  /**
   * Literal phrasing slot inside the DatePicker native Label; object/callback refs target its inner span.
   * When omitted, no separate visible date-part Label is requested.
   */
  dateLabel?: ContentSlot<'span'>;
  /**
   * Package-owned props forwarded to the DatePicker part.
   * When omitted, DatePicker part defaults apply; the parent owns its field value and disabled state.
   */
  datePickerProps?: FormDatePickerControlProps;
  /**
   * Literal phrasing slot inside the TimePicker native Label; object/callback refs target its inner span.
   * When omitted, no separate visible time-part Label is requested.
   */
  timeLabel?: ContentSlot<'span'>;
  /**
   * Package-owned props forwarded to the TimePicker part.
   * When omitted, TimePicker part defaults apply; the parent owns its field value and disabled state.
   */
  timePickerProps?: FormTimePickerControlProps;
}
```

### Source (67)

[packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts:405](https://github.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/blob/main/packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts#L405)

## FormDropdownProps

Single Dropdown stores identity and displays independent option text.
The ref targets the trigger button; `Option` children or options are exclusive.

### Imports (38)

```ts
import type { FormDropdownProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormDropdownProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormDropdownProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (38)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormDropdownProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ country: string }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'country', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }] } satisfies FormDropdownProps<{ country: string }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ country: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Dropdown {...fieldProps} label="Country" options={[{ value: "it", label: "Italy" }]} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (30)

## FormFieldPresentationProps

Presentation shared by Fluent Field wrappers; required is metadata, not a validation rule.
Slots configure inner containers; native Label/hint IDs and associations remain owned by Field.

### Imports (39)

```ts

```

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormFieldPresentationProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ reference: string }>();
const presentation: FormFieldPresentationProps = {
  label: { children: 'Reference', className: 'reference-label' },
  hint: { children: (Component, props) => <Component {...props}>Help</Component> },
};
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ reference: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Input name="reference" {...presentation} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

## FormFileInputProps

Native browser file selection stored as FileList, with null for an empty selection.
The ref targets the real HTMLInputElement; change/blur callbacks run after RHF.
Browsers cannot restore files from defaults, reset values or external values: package-owned
file fields normalize unsupported selections to null. Explicit keepDirtyValues preserves a
current native selection only while its input survives. Upload and persisted attachments are
consumer responsibilities.

### Imports (40)

```ts
import type { FormFileInputProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormFileInputProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormFileInputProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (40)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormFileInputProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ attachments: FileList | null }>();
const fieldProps: FormFileInputProps<{ attachments: FileList | null }> = { name: 'attachments' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ attachments: null }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.FileInput {...fieldProps} label="Attachments" accept="application/pdf" multiple />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (31)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

### Type (38)

```ts
type FormFileInputProps<TInput extends FieldValues> = FormControlProps<
  TInput,
  // HTMLInputElement.files and native file-clear interoperability explicitly use null.
  // eslint-disable-next-line @rushstack/no-new-null
  FileList | null
> & Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, keyof FormFieldPresentationProps | 'children' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'type' | 'value'> & {
  /**
   * Localized visible action that opens the native file chooser; omission inherits per-form `fileInput.browseLabel`.
   * When omitted, the per-form fileInput.browseLabel supplies visible action text.
   */
  browseLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Localized accessible label for clearing the native selection; omission inherits per-form `fileInput.clearLabel`.
   * When omitted, the per-form fileInput.clearLabel supplies the accessible name.
   */
  clearLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Formats the actual live native files; defaults to comma-separated file names.
   * When omitted, comma-separated actual file names are displayed; empty selection displays no names.
   * @param files - Actual live browser FileList; formatting does not upload or restore native files.
   * @returns Caller-owned React presentation of the current native selection.
   */
  formatFiles?: (files: FileList) => React.ReactNode;
}
```

## FormRadioGroupProps

Fluent RadioGroup with a public div ref and descendant error focus.
Supply Fluent Radio children or data options. Group callbacks follow RHF.

### Imports (43)

```ts
import type { FormRadioGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormRadioGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormRadioGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (43)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormRadioGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ priority: string }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'priority', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }] } satisfies FormRadioGroupProps<{ priority: string }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ priority: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.RadioGroup {...fieldProps} label="Priority" options={[{ value: "high", label: "High" }]} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

## FormRatingProps

Numeric Rating with a public div ref and error focus on an eligible native radio.
RHF changes precede consumer callbacks. No codec or default-value override exists.
Star color defaults to native `marigold`; explicit `brand` or `neutral` overrides are preserved.

### Imports (44)

```ts
import type { FormRatingProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormRatingProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormRatingProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (44)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormRatingProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ score: number }>();
const fieldProps: FormRatingProps<{ score: number }> = { name: 'score' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ score: 1 }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Rating {...fieldProps} label="Score" max={5} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```


## FormSearchBoxProps

Search string binding; dismissing writes an empty string before `onChange`.
RHF owns value/defaults and the ref targets the native input.

## FormSelectProps

Native Select for one stable string identity, or an explicitly converted domain.
Supply native `option` children or data options. RHF owns value/defaults.

### Imports (46)

```ts
import type { FormSelectProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormSelectProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormSelectProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (46)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormSelectProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ country: string }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'country', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }] } satisfies FormSelectProps<{ country: string }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ country: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Select {...fieldProps} options={[{ value: "pt", label: "Portugal" }]} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

## FormSelectionBinding

Selection bindings require an explicit lossless codec for a different live field domain.
Each mapped member correlates `name` with that path's exact read/write codec type.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (47)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormSelectProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Profile = createForm<{ countryCode: number | undefined }>();
const countryProps = {
  name: 'countryCode', label: 'Country',
  codec: {
    toControl: (value: number | undefined) => value === undefined ? '' : String(value),
    fromControl: (value: string) => value === '' ? undefined : Number(value),
  },
  options: [{ value: '39', label: 'Italy' }],
} satisfies FormSelectProps<{ countryCode: number | undefined }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Profile.Root defaultValues={{ countryCode: 39 }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values.countryCode); }}>
    <Profile.Select {...countryProps} /><Profile.Submit>Save</Profile.Submit>
  </Profile.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (37)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TValue`: Complete domain read and written by the custom control.

### Type (45)

```ts
type FormSelectionBinding<TInput extends FieldValues, TValue> = | (FormControlProps<TInput, TValue> & {
        /** Omit for the complete native string/string-array domain. */
        codec?: never })
    | { [TName in FieldPath<TInput>]: FormFieldPresentationProps & {
        /** Relative path whose exact live value is converted by this codec. */
        name: TName;
        /**
         * Domain validation when rules own validation.
         * When omitted, no field or array domain rules are registered here; schema/resolver ownership remains unchanged.
         */
        rules?: RegisterOptions<TInput, TName>;
        /** Lossless conversion; every writable control identity must round-trip. */
        codec: FormValueCodec<FieldPathValue<TInput, TName>, TValue>;
    } }[FieldPath<TInput>]
```

## FormSliderProps

Numeric slider binding; supply a valid RHF default and matching min/max/step.
No adapter fallback changes the caller's range or value. Native change/blur
callbacks run after RHF; the ref targets the range input.

### Imports (47)

```ts
import type { FormSliderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormSliderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormSliderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (48)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormSliderProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ progress: number }>();
const fieldProps: FormSliderProps<{ progress: number }> = { name: 'progress' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ progress: 20 }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Slider {...fieldProps} label="Progress" min={20} max={40} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (38)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

## FormSpinButtonProps

Numeric commit binding for Fluent SpinButton's nullable external domain.
Finite display commits become numbers; empty/nonfinite text becomes `null`.
Validation belongs to schema/rules. RHF owns value/defaults; the ref targets the
input and native change/blur callbacks run after RHF. No text-format codec exists.
A non-preserving targeted reset replaces only the Fluent primitive to clear its
internal draft; the native ref changes and existing input focus is restored.

### Imports (48)

```ts
import type { FormSpinButtonProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormSpinButtonProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormSpinButtonProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (49)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormSpinButtonProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ quantity: number | null }>();
const fieldProps: FormSpinButtonProps<{ quantity: number | null }> = { name: 'quantity' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ quantity: 0 }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.SpinButton {...fieldProps} label="Quantity" min={0} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

## FormSwatchPickerProps

SwatchPicker stores the stable string identity, independent of label and color.
Compose Fluent ColorSwatch or ImageSwatch children. The public ref targets the
root div; RHF error focus targets an enabled swatch button.
Native shape defaults to rounded; square and circular remain supported overrides.


```tsx
const fieldProps: FormSwatchPickerProps<{ theme: string }> = { name: 'theme' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ theme: 'blue' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.SwatchPicker {...fieldProps} label="Theme"><ColorSwatch value="blue" color="#0078d4" /></Order.SwatchPicker>
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

Change/blur callbacks run after RHF; required is presentation metadata.

[packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts:235](https://github.com/apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/blob/main/packages/spfx-react-toolkit/src/controls/form/form-control.types.ts#L235)

## FormTagPickerAccessibleName

TagPicker naming alternatives; rich labels require explicit text unless a settings field row supplies it.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (52)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormTagPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ people: string[] }>();
const peopleProps = {
  name: 'people', label: <strong>People</strong>, 'aria-label': 'Selected people',
  options: [{ value: 'ada', label: 'Ada Lovelace' }],
} satisfies FormTagPickerProps<{ people: string[] }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ people: [] }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values.people); }}>
    <Order.TagPicker {...peopleProps} /><Order.Submit>Save</Order.Submit>
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type (50)

```ts
type FormTagPickerAccessibleName = {
    /** Plain text visible label also names the selected-tag list. */
    label: string;
    /**
     * Explicit text overriding the label-derived accessible name when supplied.
     * When omitted, the required plain string label names the native input and selected-tag list. An enclosing SettingsGroup.Item field can instead supply their aria-labelledby relationships.
     */
    'aria-label'?: string } | {
    /**
     * Rich/object/callback or absent label needs an explicit accessible name; no text is inferred.
     * When omitted, no top-level Label is requested; inherited settings-row naming can still apply.
     */
    label?: ContentSlot<'span'>;
    /** Required text name when standalone label content is not a string. */
    'aria-label': string } | {
    /** Omit label when SettingsGroup.Item field supplies inherited naming. Standalone usage is checked at runtime. */
    label?: undefined;
    /** Omit with label only when inherited settings-row naming is available. */
    'aria-label'?: undefined }
```

## FormTagPickerProps

TagPicker with removable tags, string-array identities and a native input ref.
Options or Fluent TagPickerOption children provide identities and display text.
Omit label/aria-label only when SettingsGroup.Item field supplies inherited naming.
Ancestor context cannot be proven by TypeScript; unnamed standalone usage throws at runtime.
Query edits retain selections; reset and selection clear query presentation.

### Imports (51)

```ts
import type { FormTagPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormTagPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormTagPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (53)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormTagPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ people: string[] }>();
const fieldProps = { name: 'people', options: [{ value: 'it', label: 'Italy' }], label: 'People' } satisfies FormTagPickerProps<{ people: string[] }>;
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ people: [] }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.TagPicker {...fieldProps} label="People" options={[{ value: "ada", label: "Ada" }]} strings={{ noOptions: "No people" }} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (42)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.

### Type (51)

```ts
type FormTagPickerProps<TInput extends FieldValues> = FormSelectionProps<TInput, string[], TagPickerProps, 'aria-label' | 'children' | 'defaultSelectedOptions' | 'defaultValue' | 'name' | 'noPopover' | 'selectedOptions' | 'value' | 'onChange' | 'onBlur' | 'id'> & FormTagPickerAccessibleName & {
    /**
     * Add a Fluent colorful initials/fallback avatar to each selected tag. Defaults to false, retaining text-only tags.
     * Colors use the string option identity and remain stable when display labels change. Rich consumer labels are preserved.
     * Only presentation changes; form values, query and selection callbacks are unaffected.
     * Example: `<Order.TagPicker name="people" label="People" options={people} colorfulTagAvatars />`
     * When omitted, tags keep the native text-only presentation.
     * @defaultValue false
     */
    colorfulTagAvatars?: boolean;
    /**
     * Additional descriptions for the native query input.
     * When omitted, only adapter-owned hint/error relationships apply.
     */
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    /**
     * Input id shared with Fluent Field's label.
     * When omitted, the binding uses generated native Field/control identity.
     */
    id?: string;
    /**
     * Query callback after presentation updates; it does not change selected values.
     * When omitted, RHF updates and internal presentation still run without a consumer notification. Returned promises are not awaited.
     */
    onChange?: TagPickerInputProps['onChange'];
    /**
     * Runs after RHF marks the field touched.
     * When omitted, RHF still marks the field touched without a consumer notification. Returned promises are not awaited.
     */
    onBlur?: TagPickerInputProps['onBlur'];
    /**
     * Inner div content for the owned no-options status. Objects support attributes, refs and children callbacks.
     * Nullish values fall back to strings.noOptions; empty/boolean shorthand keeps the status shell.
     * When omitted, strings.noOptions then the per-form dictionary supply the empty-result content.
     */
    noOptionsContent?: ContentSlot<'div'>;
    /**
     * Localized package-owned query-result content.
     * When omitted, native SPFx resources and enclosing per-form dictionaries provide package-owned UI text.
     */
    strings?: Partial<FormTagPickerStrings>;
}
```

## FormTextareaProps

Multiline string binding for Fluent Textarea; RHF owns value and defaults.
Native change/blur callbacks run after RHF and the ref targets the textarea.

### Imports (53)

```ts
import type { FormTextareaProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormTextareaProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormTextareaProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (55)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormTextareaProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ notes: string }>();
const fieldProps: FormTextareaProps<{ notes: string }> = { name: 'notes' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ notes: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.Textarea {...fieldProps} label="Notes" resize="vertical" />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type (53)

```ts
type FormTimePickerChangeData = {
  /** Selected or parsed time, or `null` when cleared. */
  // Compat date/time selection and parser contracts explicitly use null for empty values.
  // eslint-disable-next-line @rushstack/no-new-null
  selectedTime: Date | null;
  /** Display text associated with the selection or freeform input. */
  selectedTimeText: string | undefined;
  /**
   * Validation error associated with the submitted time text.
   * Undefined means no direct validation message is available.
   */
  error?: FormTimePickerError;
}
```

### Examples (57)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormTimePickerControlProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ time: Date | null }>();
const timePickerProps: FormTimePickerControlProps = { freeform: true, hourCycle: 'h23', increment: 15 };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ time: null }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.TimePicker name="time" label="Time" {...timePickerProps} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type (54)

```ts
type FormTimePickerControlProps = FormDateTimeNativeInputProps & {
  /**
   * Fluent input appearance.
   * When omitted, the native Fluent primitive appearance applies.
   * @defaultValue outline
   */
  appearance?: ComboboxProps['appearance'];
  /**
   * Shows a clear action.
   * When omitted, no TimePicker clear action is requested.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  clearable?: boolean;
  /**
   * Additional class name applied to the TimePicker root.
   * When omitted, only the component and Fluent classes apply.
   */
  className?: string;
  /**
   * Date used as the fixed basis for generated and parsed times. When omitted, the current field
   * date is preserved, or local 1970-01-01 is used while the field is empty.
   */
  dateAnchor?: Date;
  /**
   * Opens the time list initially.
   * When omitted, the popup starts closed.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /**
   * Prevents interaction.
   * When omitted or false, adds no disabled restriction; enclosing Root/scope restrictions still apply.
   */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /**
   * Exclusive end hour for generated options.
   * When omitted, generated options end before hour 24.
   * @defaultValue 24
   */
  endHour?: FormTimePickerHour;
  /**
   * Localized error for rejected or uncommitted time text; omission inherits the per-form `timeInputValidationMessage` from the native resource or hook dictionary. Domain validation stays in rules/schema/resolver.
   * When omitted, the per-form dictionary supplies the corresponding date/time draft error.
   */
  inputValidationMessage?: string;
  /**
   * Allows freeform time entry.
   * When omitted, native freeform time commits are disabled.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  freeform?: boolean;
  /**
   * Synchronously formats generated/selected local time values; omission uses compat formatting with hourCycle and showSeconds.
   * When omitted, compat formatting uses hourCycle and showSeconds.
   * @param date - Required Date containing the local wall-clock time to format for generated or selected options.
   * @returns Formatted local date/time text; no UTC or timezone conversion is added.
   */
  formatDateToTimeString?: (date: Date) => string;
  /**
   * Selects the locale hour cycle.
   * When omitted, compat chooses the locale hour cycle.
   */
  hourCycle?: 'h11' | 'h12' | 'h23' | 'h24';
  /**
   * Minute interval between generated options.
   * When omitted, compat uses 30-minute options.
   * @defaultValue 30
   */
  increment?: number;
  /**
   * Renders the popup in DOM order rather than through a portal.
   * When omitted, Fluent renders the popup through its portal.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  inlinePopup?: boolean;
  /**
   * Controlled popup open state.
   * When omitted, the popup owns its open state using defaultOpen.
   */
  open?: boolean;
  /**
   * Synchronous popup-open notification; receives the proposed boolean state. Update open externally when controlled; the return value is ignored.
   * When omitted, no application popup notification runs; uncontrolled native state still updates. Returned promises are not awaited.
   * @param open - Proposed popup open state; controlled consumers must update their open prop.
   */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /**
   * Receives the native selection event and package-owned time/text/error payload after any accepted RHF write. Invalid draft notifications retain the committed value. The return value is ignored.
   * When omitted, accepted RHF writes and draft validation still occur without a consumer notification. Returned promises are not awaited.
   * @param event - React event accompanying the time selection, clear or text commit.
   * @param data - The selected or parsed time (legacy compat null for clear), its display text and an optional package-owned validation error; invalid drafts retain the previously committed time.
   */
  onTimeChange?: (event: React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLElement>, data: FormTimePickerChangeData) => void;
  /**
   * Synchronously parses possibly absent freeform text; return the parsed date (or legacy compat null) and optional error. No async parsing is supported.
   * When omitted, compat parses time text with its default parser.
   * @param timeText - Freeform time text, possibly undefined; parse synchronously.
   * @returns Parsed local time and optional validation error; legacy compat null means no parsed time.
   */
  parseTimeStringToDate?: (timeText: string | undefined) => FormTimePickerParseResult;
  /**
   * Placeholder shown when no time is selected.
   * When omitted, no placeholder text is supplied by the adapter.
   */
  placeholder?: string;
  /**
   * Includes seconds in generated and formatted options.
   * When omitted, generated time options omit seconds.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  showSeconds?: boolean;
  /**
   * Fluent input size.
   * When omitted, native Fluent input size is medium.
   * @defaultValue medium
   */
  size?: InputProps['size'];
  /**
   * Inclusive start hour for generated options.
   * When omitted, generated options start at hour 0.
   * @defaultValue 0
   */
  startHour?: FormTimePickerHour;
}
```

```tsx
const fieldProps: FormTimePickerProps<{ time: Date | null }> = { name: 'time' };
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ time: null }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values); }}>
    <Order.TimePicker {...fieldProps} label="Time" freeform hourCycle="h23" increment={15} />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

Caller validation messages, field labels and values remain caller-owned.

## FormStringsOverride

Known optional Form dictionary fields, merged per group with native resources.
Explicit empty strings are retained; calendar arrays replace complete arrays.
Supply to useForm or an initializing Root. A Root with methods inherits that
hook's dictionary. Dictionary changes do not reset or revalidate the form.

```ts
import type { FormStringsOverride } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (63)

```ts
const strings: FormStringsOverride = {
  unexpectedFailure: 'Please retry.',
  fileInput: { browseLabel: 'Choose files' },
  arraySection: { itemLabel: position => `Row ${position}` },
};
```

## FormOptionsSource

Exclusive data options or primitive child composition.
Use native `option` children for Select, Fluent Radio/Checkbox for groups,
Fluent Option for dropdowns/comboboxes, and TagPickerOption for TagPicker.

### Type (59)

```ts
type FormOptionsSource = {
    /** Stable identities and independent labels/typeahead text. */
    options: readonly FormOption[];
    /**
     * Unavailable when data options are supplied.
     * When omitted, the region has no caller content.
     */
    children?: never;
} | {
    /**
     * Unavailable when primitive children are supplied.
     * Omit this member in this configuration branch.
     */
    options?: never;
    /** Native/Fluent option composition, rendered without arbitrary child adaptation. */
    children: React.ReactNode;
}
```

## Form

Dynamic-name Form family; use createForm for input/output-aware paths.
React Hook Form owns values and validation. Render bindings inside this family's Root;
Fluent UI and date/time compat peers are required, with a shared FluentProvider.
No SPFx provider is required.
Example: `<Form.Root defaultValues={{title:''}} onSubmit={save}><Form.Input name="title" /></Form.Root>`

### Imports (67)

```ts
import { Form } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Form } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { Form } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Use when (2)

- Runtime field names prevent a statically typed createForm family.

### Avoid when (2)

- A known model can use createForm for checked live paths and output types.

### Examples (69)

#### Dynamic field editor

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Form } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';

export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return (
    <Form.Root
      defaultValues={{ reference: '' }}
      onSubmit={values => {
        console.log(values.reference);
      }}
    >
      <Form.Input name="reference" />
      <Form.Submit>Save</Form.Submit>
    </Form.Root>
  );
}
```

### Type (61)

```ts
Form: UntypedFormSuite
```

## CreateForm (type)

Typed factory overloads preserving distinct live input and submitted output.
Create suites outside render. Bound owners cannot be replaced at Root or useForm.


Creates a rules-only or Root-configured family with this live model.

A stable suite whose methods, fields and Root share one private ownership identity.

#### Parameters (83)

```ts
<TInput extends FieldValues, TOutput = TInput, TContext = unknown>(options: { schema: StandardSchemaV1<TInput, TOutput>; resolver?: undefined; } | { resolver: Resolver<TInput, TContext, TOutput>; schema?: undefined; }): FormSuite<TInput, TContext, TOutput, true>
```

Permanently binds one schema or resolver owner.

#### Type parameters (48)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TOutput`: Validated submission model, which can differ from live input; defaults to TInput where optional.
- `TContext`: Context passed to the React Hook Form resolver; defaults to unknown where optional.

#### Parameters (84)

- `options`: Exactly one validation owner; its input stays live and its output reaches onSubmit.

#### Returns (64)

A stable family with validation ownership fixed for Root and useForm.

## FormFieldResult

Semantic state returned by the custom-control binding hook; values/dirty/touched stay in RHF.

### Imports (71)

```ts
import type { FormFieldResult } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
```

### Examples (73)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormFieldResult } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ reference: string }>();
function CustomReference(): React.ReactElement {
  const field: FormFieldResult<string> = Order.useField<string>({ name: 'reference' });
  return <input ref={field.ref} value={field.value} disabled={field.disabled} onBlur={field.onBlur}
    onChange={event => field.onChange(event.currentTarget.value)} aria-label="Reference" />;
}
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root defaultValues={{ reference: '' }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values.reference); }}>
    <CustomReference />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

```ts
type FormMethods<TInput extends FieldValues = FieldValues, TContext = unknown, TOutput = TInput> = Omit<UseFormReturn<TInput, TContext, TOutput>, 'formState'> & {
```

## FormRootProps

Native Form Root props: own initialization or provide same-suite methods, never both.
noValidate defaults to true. DOM submissions share one gate across validation and save;
fields remain editable while Submit/Reset are pending. Direct handleSubmit bypasses that gate.

### Imports (75)

```ts
import type { FormRootProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormRootProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormRootProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
```

### Examples (77)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { createForm, FormRootProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/form';
const Order = createForm<{ reference: string }>();
const rootProps: FormRootProps<{ reference: string }> = {
  defaultValues: { reference: '' }, onSubmit: values => { console.log(values.reference); },
};
export function Editor(): React.ReactElement {
  return <Order.Root {...rootProps}>
    <Order.Input name="reference" />
  </Order.Root>;
}
```

### Type parameters (54)

- `TInput`: Live form record used by field paths, getValues/watch and writes.
- `TContext`: Context passed to the React Hook Form resolver; defaults to unknown where optional.
- `TOutput`: Validated submission model, which can differ from live input; defaults to TInput where optional.
- `TBound`: Whether a factory-bound validator forbids replacement at Root/useForm; defaults to false.

### Type (69)

```ts
type FormRootProps<TInput extends FieldValues = FieldValues, TContext = unknown, TOutput = TInput, TBound extends boolean = false> = FormNativeProps & {
    /**
     * Owned form content. Raw HTML injection is not supported.
     * When omitted, the region has no caller content.
     */
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Called after successful validation with TOutput. Its returned promise is awaited.
     * Records, arrays and Dates are copied before the callback; native browser objects retain identity.
     * Set friendly expected service errors through methods.setError; unexpected failures become root.submit.
     * @param values - Validated output snapshot; plain records, arrays and Dates are copied before the callback, while native browser objects retain identity.
     * @returns Void or a promise awaited by Root; unexpected failures become root.submit and pending is released.
     */
    onSubmit: (values: TOutput) => void | Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Called after failed validation with truthful RHF errors and same-suite methods.
     * A returned promise is awaited despite the notification-style void signature; failures are contained.
     * When omitted, failed validation still updates RHF errors and does not call an application notification.
     * @param errors - Truthful RHF validation errors, including the reserved unexpected-validation blocker.
     * @param methods - Same-suite enhanced RHF methods for inspecting values and setting application errors.
     */
    onInvalid?: (errors: FormErrors<TInput>, methods: FormMethods<TInput, TContext, TOutput>) => void;
    /** Adds a disabled restriction to every binding in this Root. Omitted/false adds no restriction and cannot override disabled methods or scopes. */
    disabled?: boolean;
} & ((FormUseFormProps<TInput, TContext, TOutput, TBound> & {
    /** Omit methods when Root owns initialization. */
    methods?: never;
}) | ({
    /** Same-suite methods; initialization options must be supplied to useForm instead. */
    methods: FormMethods<TInput, TContext, TOutput>;
} & {
    [TKey in Exclude<keyof FormUseFormProps<TInput, TContext, TOutput, TBound>, 'disabled'>]?: never;
}))
```
